summary: Tested admin sidebar menu visibility based on cart_enabled feature flag. All features working correctly: CRM section with Leads Kanban is always visible, cart-associated sections (Dashboard, POS, Sales, Catalog, Shipping, Marketing, Fulfillment, Johnny5) are hidden when cart_enabled=false, User Management and Accounting remain visible regardless of cart_enabled state.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx correctly implements conditional menu rendering based on cartEnabled flag (lines 150-261)
CRM section is correctly placed outside the cartEnabled conditional block (lines 222-230)
Leads Kanban is correctly nested under CRM accordion, not under Sales
User Management and Accounting are correctly placed outside cartEnabled conditional (lines 231-244)
Johnny5 Portal is correctly gated by both cartEnabled AND johnny5Settings.show_menu (lines 246-260)
Feature flags are fetched on component mount and properly update the sidebar state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin sidebar menu visibility is controlled by cart_enabled feature flag. When cart_enabled=false: only CRM (with Leads Kanban), User Management, Accounting, Live Chat, and Knowledgebase are visible. When cart_enabled=true: all cart-related sections (Dashboard, POS, Sales, Catalog, Shipping, Marketing, Fulfillment, Johnny5) become visible. Feature flag can be toggled via PUT /api/admin-settings/feature-flags with admin auth.
